Alberta Place Types

Each of Alberta's 2021 aggregate dissemination areas (ADAs) is classified into one of eight place types using 145 census indicators. Choose the place types, or any one of the 145 indicators, from the menu. Indicators are shown by quantile: each ADA's rank on the indicator among Alberta's ADAs, in fifteen equal groups, which is the form in which the indicators enter the place typology.

Source: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population, aggregate dissemination areas. Black lines: the cities of Calgary, Edmonton, and Lethbridge. Grey: no place type (no 2021 census data, or missing census indicators). Quantiles are tie-aware: ADAs with identical values share a quantile, so indicators on which many ADAs have the same value (often zero) show fewer distinct colours.
